outcome: Six scenarios on each of two models, one execution each, on one frozen revision, changing only the model string. gpt-4o-mini: 2 correct, 2 right-code-without-its-evidence, 1 wrong. gpt-4o: 5 correct, 0, 0. Model citation recall 7 of 11 against 10 of 11. The one remaining red, conflicting-evidence, is IDENTICAL on both: each cites a ref no agent reported and the chain refuses it, so that is a defect in the prompt or the contract rather than in the model.
what_this_establishes: Coverage on six cases, paired. NOT reliability: one execution per scenario per model, and the contract forbids the claim.
what_it_closed: The citations were not a prompt problem. Seven rewrites had not produced deployment.image or limits.memory; gpt-4o cites them with no prompt change at all.
deployment-regression was not a fixture ceiling. With the times in front of it, gpt-4o orders the rollout before the errors and names the right code; mini could not, three purchases running.
Three identical aggregates were the model's ceiling, not remaining variance in the harness.

totals.why: The per-node usage now travels with the answer, but these two runs were issued from a deployment recorded before that reached the webhook reply for every path. The token measurement of the same day, docs/runs/2026-09-10-token-measurement.json, holds 11249 in and 750 out for one whole mini run; a gpt-4o run of the same shape is dearer per token and no rate is established here.
